name: Create Medication
description: Register a Medication resource in the FHIR server, including drug code (RxNorm/SNOMED), status, dose form, and batch/lot details.

intent_examples: Add a medication to the formulary
when_to_use: User wants to create a Medication resource
User wants to register a drug in the system
User wants to add a medication to the formulary
when_not_to_use: User wants to prescribe a medication (use MedicationRequest)
User wants to dispense medication (use MedicationDispense)
User wants to record medication administration

introduction: I'll help you register a new medication — including its drug code, status, dose form, and batch information.

workflow_steps.name: Create Medication
workflow_steps.description: Search for the drug by RxNorm or SNOMED code, set the status and dose form, and optionally record batch details.
